ipxact:component.ipxact:name: efx_dphy_bidir_rx
ipxact:component.ipxact:description: The MIPI D-PHY is a scalable physical layer for interfacing various components such as cameras and displays to host devices. The MIPI D-PHY Controller core allows you to control and configure the MIPI D-PHY interface. You use the MIPI D-PHY Controller core with the Titanium HSIO pins configured as MIPI lanes to build a custom MIPI interface.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tLPX_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tCLK_TERM_EN_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tD_TERM_EN_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_SETTLE_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_PREPARE_ZERO_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: HS_BYTECLK_MHZ
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: MIPI parallel clock frequency in Mhz to support data rate of 80 Mbps to 1,500 Mbps.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: CLOCK_FREQ_MHZ
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: IP core clock frequency in Mhz.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_USER_DESKEWCAL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:displayName: Enable user setting on RX data IO lane dynamic delay
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Allows you to control the RX data I/O lane dynamic delay.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: DPHY_CLOCK_MODE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: To enable discontinuous or continuous HS mode clock.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ENABLE_BIDIR
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enable bidirectional data lane. Applicable to bidirectional mode only. Default: 1

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tLP_EXIT_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: BTA_TIMEOUT_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Bus turnaround timeout parameter in ns. If the DPHY RX does not respond within this period, DPHY TX ends the turnaround request. Applicable to bidirectional mode only.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_PREPARE_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Values according to MIPI D-PHY specifications.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tWAKEUP_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_EXIT_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_ZERO_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: tHS_TRAIL_NS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Soft D-PHY timing parameter in ns.
